text: I’m creating a fantasy game on my own.
I know the world I want to build, but I don’t have a dedicated art or animation team.
Ready-made assets can give me a starting point, but I wanted something that felt like part of my own world.
So I started building a living spellbook with Muse.
With Muse, I developed the artwork for the book, its decoration, and its spells.
Each element was generated, selected, and cleaned before it went onto the page.
I mapped every layer to the curvature of the illustrated pages,
then added typography, ornaments, and interaction.
Muse also created the animated spell sequences.
Ice Storm brings the page into motion.
Frost Breath reveals an icy dragon.
Absolute Zero freezes and shatters a knight.
This is the working Unity application, running in real time.
AI made this visual production achievable without a dedicated art team.
I kept control of the world and its presentation.
